name: Bloodworth Academy Occult Club
source:
After rebelling one too many times, your parents have enrolled you in a prestigious, secluded boarding school, hoping to set you straight. However, you quickly discover that your new campus is a playground for the supernatural. As if that wasn't surprising enough, you're forced by the school's rigorous rules to join a club or risk expulsion. Thankfully, the newly-established occult club offers you a spot, conditional on proving your worth.

After some trials and tribulations, you've earned your place as the fourth club member. While you're eager to delve into the school’s secrets, it seems your clubmates have other distractions in mind… Because what's romance without a touch of mystery?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.occultclub]Google Play[/url]]
